checks.detail: An unsettled effect produces a parked result rather than successful termination
A failed terminal commit retains ownership and emits no success; convergence can be retried
Absence and cached UI messages cannot authorize replay; task reconciliation requires an explicit canonical input read port
Observer failures do not retry effects, and stale generations cannot settle the active run
Required canonical writes cannot be waived as a harmless projection failure
A completion observer can admit a new turn without deadlocking ownership or duplicating its conclusion
Concurrent initialization shares one owner, disposes partial failure, permits retry, and rejects a foreign workspace binding
A driver complete with an unsettled effect cannot publish a successful task conclusion
Persisted delivery attempts hold unknown inputs; admission preserves original attachments and hidden options
Length, error and aborted outcomes keep distinct canonical causes and never trigger automatic continuation
A late paid auxiliary result survives UI deletion and an observer exception without changing the foreground checkpoint
Reverse tool completion cannot settle its unfinished sibling; an incorrect session identity is rejected
Recovery and canonical queries work after reopening without a session application
Database restore requires drained execution and restores canonical facts from a verified backup
Non-cooperative resources cannot hang shutdown or reopen a closed database; unknown effects retain recovery evidence
